content.short: StakeMON.ad is a staking portal for delegating MON to Monad validators.
content.description: StakeMON.ad provides a front end for delegating MON, with assistance in picking a validator rather than leaving the choice to a raw list. Concentration of stake is a real governance concern on new chains, and how delegation interfaces order their lists has more influence over it than most people assume.
content.meta: A delegation front end for MON, where list ordering quietly shapes stake concentration.
